devTools.note: Table-driven mocha suites become #[test] functions iterating over case tables in tests/*.rs. Built into cargo, no crate.
Type stubs for the test runner; the Rust compiler needs nothing.
Coverage is not part of the contract. cargo-llvm-cov is an optional local tool, not a dependency.
The compiler is the type checker (ecosystems/rust.md section 7).
Runs TypeScript tests without a build step; cargo test compiles directly.
UMD bundling for browsers has no Rust equivalent; the crate is the only artifact.
